name: Hue to Hoi An
summary: Da Nang is the stop in the middle. The door-to-door drive to Hoi An is check on arrival. The Hai Van pass itself is about 22 km and nearly an hour.

modes.note: The pass road is about 22 km and nearly an hour if nothing goes wrong. The tunnel is more than 12 km and takes 10–15 minutes. A Hue door to Hoi An door time is not published.

modes.mode: Train to Da Nang, then car
modes.duration: 2 hours 30 minutes to 3 hours 20 minutes to Da Nang
modes.note: Then Hoi An is check on arrival. The heritage train prints two clocks, so use that day’s ticket.

seoTitle: Hue to Hoi An route — Hai Van pass, then the train
seoDescription: Hai Van pass is about 22 km and nearly an hour. The tunnel takes 10 to 15 minutes. The full drive to Hoi An, and the ride on from Da Nang, are check on arrival.

faqs.q: Can you stop in Da Nang?
faqs.a: Yes. The Marble Mountains sit on the road between Da Nang and Hoi An.
